mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY p.code
